nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: You smell like diesel. That's the nicest thing anyone's done this week.

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: One vial. No paperwork. If anyone asks, it expired.

nodes.speaker: dell
nodes.text: Where are you getting the rest of your fuel, Ames?

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: From people who can get it. Don't ask what I pay them in. Next.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: On the way out, a teenage boy in a Bridge Boys bandana passes you, carrying a cooler toward Ames's office.
